name: Bhimashankar Jungle Trek (Ganesh Ghat / Shidi Ghat)
tagline: A wildlife sanctuary trek to a Jyotirlinga pilgrimage site — two routes, two very different difficulty levels
seoTitle: Bhimashankar Jungle Trek Solo Guide — The Solo Trail
seoDescription: Solo trekker's guide to the Bhimashankar jungle trek via Ganesh Ghat and Shidi Ghat — wildlife sanctuary notes, leopard sightings, and route choice.

seasons.label: Jun – Sep
seasons.sub: Monsoon — waterfalls and greenery at their best; Shidi Ghat especially risky wet

seasons.label: Oct – Feb
seasons.sub: Drier, safer footing especially on Shidi Ghat

routeOptions.name: Ganesh Ghat (from Khandas)
routeOptions.notes: Gradual, beginner-friendly ascent through sanctuary forest.

routeOptions.name: Shidi Ghat
routeOptions.notes: Three ladder-like rock steps ('shidi' = ladder) — treacherous when wet. Experienced trekkers only; not recommended in monsoon.

permits.name: Sanctuary entry
permits.fullName: Bhimashankar Wildlife Sanctuary entry (~131 sq km)
permits.notes: Standard wildlife sanctuary entry rules and a modest fee apply.

safety.intro: This trek passes through a wildlife sanctuary with reported leopard activity, and the Shidi Ghat route adds real technical/fall risk on top of that.

alerts.title: Leopard sightings reported in the sanctuary
alerts.body: Bhimashankar Wildlife Sanctuary protects the Indian giant squirrel and has occasional leopard sightings. Local trail dogs often signal an animal's presence before trekkers spot it — take that seriously if it happens.

alerts.title: Shidi Ghat's ladder-like rock steps are treacherous wet
alerts.body: This route has three step-like rock sections that become genuinely dangerous in rain. Take Ganesh Ghat instead if conditions are wet or you're not experienced with technical scrambling.

cards.title: Before you go
items: Choose Ganesh Ghat if solo or inexperienced — save Shidi Ghat for a dry-season, experienced-group attempt
Check current sanctuary entry rules and timings

cards.title: On the trail
items: Make noise on forest sections at dawn/dusk given wildlife activity
Carry a whistle in case you need to signal for help in dense forest

cards.title: Solo-specific
items: Prefer Ganesh Ghat solo — it's the more traveled and less technical route
Tell someone your exact route choice given the two options differ so much in risk

items.name: Grippy trekking shoes (essential, especially for Shidi Ghat)
